page_title: BUR 0-3 MCI | Burnley v Manchester City 11/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Substitution. Kyle Walker makes his way off the pitch and James McAtee (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.
90+4' He’s off! Anass Zaroury (Burnley) gets his marching orders from referee Craig Pawson after the VAR review.

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Anass Zaroury (Burnley), but referee Craig Pawson must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+3' This is a yellow card! Anass Zaroury (Burnley) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+1' Here is a change. Lyle Foster is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Redmond (Burnley).
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Josh Brownhill (Burnley) for Sander Berge.
90+1' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

88' Phil Foden (Manchester City) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
87' A fan invades the pitch and the game has to be interrupted!

86' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, James Trafford anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
84' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

84' Sander Berge (Burnley) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Corner kick. Burnley will have an opportunity.
82' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
82' Burnley have a corner.
81' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Erling Haaland will be replaced by Cole Palmer (Manchester City).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch so that Rico Lewis can be given a rest.
79' The substitution is prepared. Aymeric Laporte (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nathan Ake.
79' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
75' 0 - 3 Goal! 0:3. The ball rebounds to Rodri (Manchester City) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

75' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
75' Pep Guardiola is stunned as referee Craig Pawson shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Beyer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley).
73' The attendance is 21572.
71' Good defending. Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
68' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
68' Rodri (Manchester City) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Burnley.
64' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Burnley.
61' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Zeki Amdouni is replaced by Anass Zaroury (Burnley).
61' Substitution. Luca Koleosho walks off the pitch and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.

61' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
60' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester City. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Rodri (Manchester City) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but James Trafford is alert and denies him.
56' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

55' Rodri (Manchester City) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but James Trafford was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' A dangerous looking corner kick from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared to safety by the defence.
54' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

53' A pass lands at the feet of Erling Haaland (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Lyle Foster (Burnley) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
47' A pass from Luca Koleosho (Burnley) is intercepted by Ederson and the move breaks down.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Rodri (Manchester City) sends a long ball in, but James Trafford comfortably gathers the ball.
45+4' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' Ederson (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
40' The foul by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' 0 - 2 Julian Alvarez passes the ball into the penalty area. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:2!
34' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Some neat passing and movement from Manchester City as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

30' Lyle Foster (Burnley) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
27' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
23' Kevin De Bruyne is substituted due to injury. Pep Guardiola gives a chance to Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
22' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
20' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Ederson is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
18' Rodri (Manchester City) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
17' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) is penalised for holding. Craig Pawson signals a set piece. Manchester City have a free kick.
15' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.

13' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
11' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Manchester City earn a free kick.
9' Craig Pawson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kyle Walker (Manchester City). There is a free kick near the sideline to Burnley.

6' A short pass finds Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

4' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Rodri, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who beats James Trafford with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Craig Pawson.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
